svg.title: River town, compiled Dream geometry
svg.desc: Roads and intersections are unions of the actual world geometry. Building footprints, entrances, transit stops and bridges come from the same compiled Dream source as the game.

g.text: A city has to make sense.
Compiled Dream geometry · 1.4 × 1.1 km · roads, entrances, platforms and bridges share the game source
Charcoal: rail · Rust: tram · Violet: buses · Green: cycle tracks · Tan: entrance paths · Dots: route stops
